title: SQL Injection Login Bypass
impact: Bypass authentication and gain administrator access.
remediation: Use parameterized queries and input validation.

title: SQL Injection Data Extraction
column17: Extract sensitive user records including password hashes.
column18: Use parameterized queries and sanitize search inputs.

title: Reflected XSS
impact: Execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser.
remediation: Sanitize and encode all user-supplied input before reflecting it.

title: Stored XSS
impact: Store malicious scripts that execute when users view the page.
remediation: Sanitize and encode all stored input.
